# You Only Look Once: Unified Real-Time Object Detection

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, Ali Farhadi  
**Year:** 2015  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1506.02640](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1506.02640)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02640](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02640)

**Keywords:** yolo, object detection, real-time

## Abstract

We present YOLO a new approach to object detection. A single neural network predicts bounding boxes and class probabilities directly from full images in one evaluation.
